record.question: Why should glasswares be placed on a heat-resistant surface during heating?
record.explanation: Answer A: Prevent thermal shock. A heat-resistant surface protects the bench and reduces abrupt temperature transfer when hot glassware is placed down; the source’s “prevent thermal shock” is the closest offered rationale but is imprecise. Reference: https://bionmr.unl.edu/files/misc/mediawikidownloads/EHS_SOPs/Laboratory/Ground%20Glass%20and%20Glassware%20Safety_SOP_7.09.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
